card.name: Sedation endings and "of" after nouns
card.fires_on: The ending "ation" in sedation (after "sed"), and the word "of" right after nouns like "part" or "members" in general prose.

modes.description: The word "of" following "part" or "members" in ordinary narrative text.
modes.example: They’d give you one of the books as part<< of>> your pay.
